title: GRAVITAS GCS Deployment Architecture
description: Runtime deployment topology showing the GRAVITAS GCS as a local-first application with logical process groups, platform abstraction layer, physical interfaces, local data stores, and optional remote synchronization boundary. Does not prescribe specific deployment technologies or mandate separate OS processes for each engine.

groups.label: GRAVITAS GCS — Local Deployment Boundary
groups.description: Primary deployment boundary. The GCS operates as a local-first application. All critical functionality is available without mandatory cloud connectivity.

metadata.notes: Local-first per req-2.14 and AS-001. Process boundaries within are logical, not deployment-prescriptive (AS-002, UD-003).

groups.label: Application Services
groups.description: Logical process groups for application-layer services. May be deployed as a single process or multiple processes depending on platform and scale requirements.

metadata.notes: Internal grouping is logical. Deployment as separate processes is a platform decision (UD-003).

groups.label: Platform Abstraction Layer
groups.description: Cross-platform runtime, OS compatibility, device interface abstraction, dependency management, and performance monitoring. Isolates domain logic from OS-specific code.

metadata.notes: All 10 cross-platform engines (Category C) reside here. Enables req-GA-011.

groups.label: Physical Interfaces
groups.description: Hardware and network interfaces through which the GCS communicates with vehicles and external systems. Managed by the platform abstraction layer.

metadata.notes: Physical layer. Interface types from req-2.2-001: serial, USB, TCP, UDP, radio, IP-based.

groups.label: Local Data Stores
groups.description: Local persistence for application data, telemetry history, media assets, and configuration. Technology-agnostic per UD-002.

metadata.notes: Local-first storage. No specific database technology prescribed (UD-002).

groups.label: Optional Remote Services
groups.description: Remote synchronization targets and external services. Not required for core GCS operation. Connectivity is optional per req-2.14.

metadata.notes: Dashed boundary indicates optional. GCS must function fully without remote connectivity (AS-001, req-2.14-001).

nodes.label: Operator
nodes.description: Human operator interacting with the GCS through the local UI. May have role-based access restrictions.

metadata.notes: Multiple concurrent operators supported per req-2.9-011

nodes.label: Connected Vehicles
nodes.description: UAVs, UGVs, and other unmanned systems connected through physical communication links. Vehicle types are extensible.

inputs: Commands and mission uploads from GCS
metadata.notes: External systems. Not part of GCS deployment.

nodes.label: Core Services
nodes.description: Vehicle registry, protocol adapters, telemetry ingestion, event processing, API gateway, schema management, plugin framework

responsibilities: Internal API gateway and schema validation
metadata.notes: Maps to subsystem A (doc-core-01 through doc-core-05)

nodes.label: UI & COP Rendering
nodes.description: Common Operational Picture, map visualization, sensor overlays, dashboards, operator interaction surfaces

responsibilities: Display vehicle positions, tracks, and status
Manage map layers, overlays, and symbols
Present sensor FOV and coverage overlays
constraints: Must distinguish live vs stale vs estimated data (req-2.3-014)
metadata.notes: Maps to subsystems D (COP) and parts of K (dashboards)

nodes.label: Communication Services
nodes.description: Transport management, multi-network routing, link monitoring, encryption, failover, offline queue management

responsibilities: Manage serial, USB, TCP, UDP, radio, IP transports
Monitor link quality, latency, bandwidth, packet loss
constraints: Must define failure behavior for every critical path (req-GA-009)
metadata.notes: Maps to subsystem B (doc-comm-01 through doc-comm-05)

nodes.label: Operations & Planning
nodes.description: Command & control, mission lifecycle, fleet management, path planning, vehicle configuration, preflight, recovery

responsibilities: Command validation, dispatch, and outcome tracking
Mission planning, validation, execution, and monitoring
constraints: Every command through auth and safety (req-GA-007)
metadata.notes: Maps to subsystems E (planning) and F (operations)

nodes.label: Background Services
nodes.description: Workflow automation, rules engine, AI diagnostics, anomaly detection, data synchronization, scheduled tasks

responsibilities: Run AI-assisted diagnostics and anomaly detection
outputs: Automated actions to ops (through standard command pathway)
metadata.notes: Maps to subsystem K (customization) and parts of J (sync)

nodes.label: Cross-Platform Runtime
nodes.description: Runtime abstraction, OS compatibility, dependency detection, device interface management, configuration environment, update management

responsibilities: Abstract OS-specific interfaces from domain logic
Detect OS version, runtime dependencies, environment
Manage device interfaces and driver compatibility
Manage application updates and version migration
outputs: Platform services to all application services above
metadata.notes: All 10 Category C engines. Detailed in doc-master-03 and doc-test-03.

nodes.label: Performance & Resource Monitor
nodes.description: Application performance monitoring, resource utilization, process health, watchdog services

responsibilities: Monitor CPU, memory, storage, network utilization
Detect crashes, service failures, resource exhaustion
Provide watchdog and service health checks
inputs: Performance metrics from all application services
outputs: Health data to storage and alerting
constraints: Monitoring must not degrade application performance
metadata.notes: eng-plat-app-performance, eng-plat-resource-monitoring, eng-sec-watchdog

nodes.label: Host Operating System
nodes.description: The validated target operating system providing kernel services, file system, networking stack, and device driver framework. Specific OS not prescribed.

responsibilities: Manage file system and storage access
constraints: Only explicitly validated OS versions supported (req-2.13-014)
metadata.notes: External to GCS. Compatibility tested per req-2.13 and doc-test-03.

nodes.label: Network Interfaces
nodes.description: TCP, UDP, and IP-based network interfaces for vehicle communication, remote connectivity, and local networking

responsibilities: Provide TCP, UDP, IP-based transport interfaces
outputs: Network traffic to/from vehicles and remote services
metadata.notes: Managed by platform device interface layer

nodes.label: Serial / USB / Radio Interfaces
nodes.description: Serial port, USB, and radio communication interfaces for direct vehicle and controller connections

responsibilities: Provide serial and USB transport interfaces
Handle device enumeration and driver binding
outputs: Device data to/from vehicles and controllers
constraints: Driver availability depends on host OS (req-2.13-005)
metadata.notes: Managed by eng-plat-device-interface

nodes.label: Application Data Store
nodes.description: Local persistence for vehicle records, missions, configuration, telemetry history, logs, events, and audit records. Technology-agnostic.

responsibilities: Store structured telemetry and time-series data
Maintain logs, events, and audit records
metadata.notes: Logical data store. Physical implementation is a deployment decision.

nodes.label: Media & Object Store
nodes.description: Local storage for video recordings, images, sensor captures, and associated metadata. Separate from structured data.

responsibilities: Store video recordings, snapshots, and captures
Associate media with vehicles, missions, timestamps
Handle expired media and stale references
metadata.notes: eng-payload-media-storage. Separate from structured data store.

nodes.label: Remote Sync Endpoint
nodes.description: Optional remote service for data synchronization, backup, and multi-site coordination. Not required for local GCS operation.

inputs: Sync data from local GCS when connectivity available
metadata.notes: Optional. GCS operates fully offline. Dashed group boundary indicates optionality.

semantic.label: Operator Interaction
semantic.dataType: User input: commands, mission edits, configuration changes, map interactions
semantic.description: Operator interacts with the GCS through the local UI. All actions subject to authentication and authorization.

semantic.label: Vehicle Telemetry (via physical links)
semantic.dataType: Raw telemetry, status, acknowledgements from vehicles through serial, USB, radio, or network
semantic.description: Vehicles transmit telemetry through physical communication links. Data arrives at the GCS through hardware interfaces and is delivered to communication services.

semantic.label: Commands to Vehicles (via physical links)
semantic.dataType: Commands, mission uploads, configuration changes to vehicles
semantic.description: Commands are dispatched through communication services to physical interfaces and transmitted to vehicles. Acknowledgement tracking is separate.

semantic.label: Transport Data → Core
semantic.dataType: Raw vehicle data received through communication transports for protocol decoding
semantic.description: Communication services deliver raw transport data to core services for protocol-specific decoding and normalization.

semantic.label: State & Events → UI
semantic.dataType: Normalized vehicle state, position updates, status changes, system events
semantic.description: Core services push normalized state and events to the UI for real-time COP rendering.

semantic.label: Vehicle API → Operations
semantic.dataType: Vehicle registry, adapter interfaces, capability profiles, command APIs
semantic.description: Core provides vehicle services API to operations for command dispatch and mission management.

semantic.label: Telemetry & Events → Storage
semantic.dataType: Normalized telemetry records, system events, vehicle state history
semantic.description: Core services persist telemetry and events to local data store for history, replay, and analysis.

semantic.label: Records → Storage
semantic.dataType: Mission records, command history, execution outcomes, preflight results, planning records
semantic.trigger: Mission lifecycle and command completion events
semantic.description: Operations persists mission, command, and planning records to local data store.

semantic.label: Media Access
semantic.dataType: Video streams, recordings, snapshots, media metadata
semantic.description: UI accesses media storage for live video display, recording playback, and image review.

semantic.label: Platform Services
semantic.dataType: OS abstraction, runtime services, device interfaces, environment configuration
semantic.description: All application services depend on the platform abstraction layer for OS-independent runtime services. Representative edge from core; applies to all app services.
assumptions: Single representative edge. All app services consume platform services.

semantic.label: OS Interfaces
semantic.dataType: System calls, file I/O, network sockets, device enumeration
semantic.description: Platform abstraction layer consumes OS-specific interfaces and presents them as OS-independent services to the application.

semantic.label: Hardware Access
semantic.dataType: Device driver interfaces, network stack, serial port access
semantic.description: Host OS provides hardware access to physical interfaces through device drivers. Representative edge to network; also applies to serial/USB/radio.

semantic.label: Data Synchronization (optional)
semantic.dataType: Queued operational data, conflict resolution messages, sync state
semantic.description: Background services synchronize local data with remote endpoint when connectivity is available. Offline queue is maintained during disconnection.

semantic.label: Health Metrics → Storage
semantic.dataType: Performance metrics, resource utilization, watchdog events, health status
semantic.description: Performance and resource monitor persists health metrics to local storage for diagnostics and alerting.

requirementsCoverage.description: Cross-platform separation: domain logic independent of OS-specific interfaces
requirementsCoverage.notes: Platform abstraction layer isolates all application services from OS-specific code.

requirementsCoverage.description: Separate core domain logic from OS-specific functionality
requirementsCoverage.notes: Core services consume platform services through abstraction layer.

requirementsCoverage.description: Support the explicitly validated target operating systems
requirementsCoverage.notes: Specific OS targets not named in requirements. Compatibility matrix in doc-test-03.

requirementsCoverage.description: Detect available interfaces, drivers and permissions
requirementsCoverage.notes: Platform device interface engine handles driver detection and binding.

requirementsCoverage.description: Avoid advertising compatibility with untested operating systems or environments
requirementsCoverage.notes: Host OS node explicitly constrained to validated versions only.

requirementsCoverage.description: Support configured serial, USB, TCP, UDP, radio and IP-based transports
requirementsCoverage.notes: Physical interfaces split into network (TCP/UDP/IP) and device (serial/USB/radio) groups.

requirementsCoverage.description: Support local GCS operation without mandatory cloud connectivity
requirementsCoverage.notes: Remote sync group has dashed boundary indicating optionality. All critical services are local.

requirementsCoverage.description: Queue eligible records for later synchronization
requirementsCoverage.notes: Background services manage offline queue; sync occurs when connectivity returns.

requirementsCoverage.description: Persist vehicle records, missions, settings, configuration and operational history
requirementsCoverage.notes: Local application data store receives data from core and operations.

requirementsCoverage.description: Track stored media separately from references to media
requirementsCoverage.notes: Media store is a separate node from the structured data store, reflecting physical separation.

requirementsCoverage.description: Define measurable latency targets for telemetry, commands, events and UI updates
requirementsCoverage.notes: Performance monitor measures latency. Specific targets not defined in requirements (UD-009).

requirementsCoverage.description: Measure CPU, memory, storage and network utilization
requirementsCoverage.notes: Resource monitoring engine in platform layer.

requirementsCoverage.description: Network resilience: every critical communication path must define failure and recovery behavior
requirementsCoverage.notes: Communication services node encompasses failover and recovery. Detailed in doc-comm-05.

requirementsCoverage.description: Offline resilience: locally available functionality and synchronization behavior explicitly defined
requirementsCoverage.notes: Deployment topology explicitly shows local-first with optional remote sync.

assumptions.description: The GCS is primarily a local-first application. Cloud/remote connectivity is optional and additive.
assumptions.justification: Requirements mandate offline operation (req-2.14) and local command authority.

assumptions.description: All engines are logical components. Deployment as separate processes is not assumed unless requirements specify it.
assumptions.justification: Requirements state clear service boundaries but do not mandate microservice deployment.

assumptions.description: Remote synchronization endpoint is optional. The GCS must function fully without it.
assumptions.justification: Requirements explicitly state local operation without mandatory cloud connectivity (req-2.14-001).

unresolvedDecisions.description: No specific communication protocols named in requirements.
unresolvedDecisions.impact: Physical interface nodes show abstract transport types (serial, USB, TCP, UDP, radio, IP) without protocol binding.
Data stores shown as logical cylinders without vendor or technology labels.

unresolvedDecisions.description: Deployment topology (monolith vs microservices vs hybrid) not mandated.
unresolvedDecisions.impact: Application services group uses dashed internal boundary. Process grouping is logical, not prescriptive.

unresolvedDecisions.description: Vehicle categories beyond UAV/UGV mentioned but not enumerated.
unresolvedDecisions.impact: Vehicle node labeled generically as 'Connected Vehicles' with extensibility note.
Background services node includes AI diagnostics as an abstract capability.

unresolvedDecisions.description: Cloud vs on-premise vs edge deployment not specified.
unresolvedDecisions.impact: Remote sync endpoint shown as optional cloud icon. No specific infrastructure prescribed.
Performance monitor node references configurable thresholds without specific numbers.
